items.description: Laptop damage payment - cracked screen and lower-right corner impact damage
items.rationale: Covered under 2.6.1(b) and 2.6.2 (thrown against a fixed interior part of a conveyance during an evasive swerve); screen and corner are one loss on one unit under 2.6.3 and 7.1.5. Under 7.1.10 repair is capped at the cost of an equivalent new unit, EUR 1,400; reference case 2 showed screen plus corner repair at EUR 1,150 or more, so t sits at or just under the cap, with no deductible figure given.
